leads.title: Provision 008/2013-CG - General Inspectorate of Justice of Rondonia / Diario da Justica Eletronico
leads.documents: Direct qualification for same-sex marriage and conversion of stable union into marriage in civil registries of Rondonia
leads.detail: Provision 008/2013-CG, published 26 April 2013 in Diario da Justica Eletronico. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Brazilian Supreme Federal Court (STF) 2019 ruling on homophobia/transphobia
leads.documents: Criminalizes discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity by equating it with crime of racism; applies in Rondonia absent state-specific law
leads.detail: Cited as 2019 STF ruling equating LGBT discrimination with racism. No URL visible.

leads.title: 2025 Joint Recommendation - MPF, MPRO, MPT, DPU, DPE-RO
leads.documents: Recommends measures to protect LGBTQ community in Rondonia, including training on sexual orientation and gender identity for police and firefighters and inclusion of LGBTQ population data in official reports
leads.detail: Signed in 2025 by Federal Public Prosecutor's Office (MPF), Public Prosecutor's Office of State of Rondonia (MPRO), Labor Prosecutor (MPT), Public Defender's Office of the Union (DPU), Public Defender's Office of Rondonia (DPE-RO). No URL visible.

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling 1 March 2018 on gender identity
leads.documents: Right of transgender person to change official name and sex by self-declaration of psychosocial identity without surgery or professional evaluation

leads.title: Hanier Miranda X-marker case - Center for Legal Practices, Research and Extensions (NPPEJ) at Catholic Faculty of Porto Velho
leads.documents: First birth certificate in Rondonia with sex marker 'X' in July 2022 after initial registry denial and year-long lawsuit
leads.detail: July 2022, filed by NPPEJ at Catholic Faculty of Porto Velho. No URL visible.

leads.title: Ordinance signed 28 August 2025 by Appellate Judge Daniel Ribeiro Lagos
leads.documents: Guarantees transgender people use of social name and use of bathrooms and locker rooms in accordance with gender identity
leads.detail: Signed 28 August 2025 by Daniel Ribeiro Lagos. No URL visible.

leads.title: State Law no. 5,123 (2021) - Legislative Assembly of Rondonia / Governor Marcos Rocha
leads.documents: Banned use of gender-neutral language in schools; proposed by Deputy Eyder Brasil (Social Liberal Party), signed 19 October 2021
leads.detail: Law no. 5,123, approved October 2021, signed by Governor Marcos Rocha on the 19th. No URL visible.

leads.title: ADI by National Confederation of Workers in Educational Establishments / STF decision 10 February 2023 (Justice Edson Fachin injunction November 2021)
leads.documents: Challenge and invalidation of State Law 5,123; Fachin blocked enforcement via preliminary injunction for violating Federal legislative authority, upheld by Supreme Court
leads.detail: ADI filed with STF; injunction November 2021 by Justice Edson Fachin; final STF decision 10 February 2023 striking down law. No URL visible.

leads.title: Law of 10 July 2026 on parental authorization - struck down by Court of Justice of Rondonia 17 August
leads.documents: Required parental authorization for classes on sexual orientation, sexual diversity, gender identity and gender equality; enacted by Assembly President Alex Redano after Governor Marcos Rocha neither vetoed nor signed; struck down
leads.detail: Passed 10 July 2026, enacted by Alex Redano, struck down 17 August by Court of Justice of Rondonia. No URL visible.

leads.title: ANTRA report 28 January 2022; 2020-2021 police reports data; Programa Atenas 2022 assessment
leads.documents: 12 murders of transgender people in Rondonia 2017-2021 (3rd highest homicide rate in North Region); 240 police reports of violence against LGBTQ 2020-2021; Rondonia named worst state for LGBTQ public policies in 2022
leads.detail: National Association of Travestis and Transsexuals (ANTRA) report published 28 January 2022; Programa Atenas 2022 ranking. No URL visible.
